paragraphs: Collected from the last three rollouts; every item cost someone an evening.
Two habits that survived every retrospective:

list_items.text: Start with the deployment checklist before touching production.
Review the changelog with the on-call engineer
Keep the cable ties with the spares, not the toolbox
Label both ends of every run before it leaves the bench
